title: Law to require rules-of-road notices on bike and scooter share apps
summary: This bill would require operators of shared bike and scooter systems, like Citi Bike, to display safe-riding rules to users through their apps and at physical docking stations. Users would need to review the rules at least once a year before unlocking a device, and apps could not charge for the time spent reviewing them. Physical station displays would be required within one year of the law taking effect.
